summary.zh-CN: 影人可由皮革或纸制成。

summary.en: Puppeteers move the figures with rods.
summary.zh-CN: 艺人通过签杆操纵影人。

summary.en: Music and singing accompany the visual performance.
summary.zh-CN: 音乐和演唱伴随视觉表演。

summary.en: Figures may have twelve to twenty-four movable joints.
summary.zh-CN: 影人可能具有十二至二十四个活动关节。

summary.en: Some performers also carve their own puppets.
summary.zh-CN: 部分表演者也雕刻制作自己的影人。

summary.en: Small and large troupes share the performance work.
summary.zh-CN: 小型与大型戏班共同分担表演工作。

summary.en: Skills pass through families, troupes and apprenticeships.
summary.zh-CN: 技艺通过家庭、戏班及师徒关系传承。

summary.en: UNESCO inscribed Chinese shadow puppetry in 2011.
summary.zh-CN: 中国皮影戏于2011年列入联合国教科文组织名录。

summary.en: Backlighting brings figures into view on a translucent screen.
summary.zh-CN: 背后的灯光让影人在半透明幕布上显现。

Jinzhou forged-copper relief pictures are listed among traditional arts.
Gaizhou stilt yangge is listed as a folk dance from Gaizhou.
Huqin making is listed with Fuxin as its declaring city.
Liaoyang drum music appears in Liaoning’s first provincial heritage list.
Tieling’s Korean-community Shangyuan festival is listed among provincial folk customs.
Chaoyang folk drum music is listed among provincial traditional music projects.
Liao River estuary fishing-community food processing and customs are listed under Panjin.
Western Liaoning taiping drum is listed as a folk dance from Suizhong.
